additional_info.subject: RE: ID0382842-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P2 170000122] Internal error CRM:01811000369
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr.Grun,
Hope you are doing well,
The error you're seeing seems to be related to the V2G (Vehicle-to-Grid) side.
I just wanted to clarify that if there's an issue during the charging session—like an authentication failure or a communication error with the vehicle.it can result in an internal error on OCPP, followed by a "faulted" message.
This doesn't necessarily mean there's a malfunction with the charger itself. In most cases, these errors are due to communication issues with the vehicle, rather than a problem with the charger.
I will forward this case to our OCPP experts for further analysis to help identify the root cause of the issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
